Java 虚拟线程在哪个 JDK 版本正式发布，synchronized 导致的线程固定问题在哪个版本改善？引用 JEP。

**结果：** `COMPLETED_WITH_LIMITATIONS`

## 结论汇总

| 研究对象 | JDK 版本号 | JEP 编号与标题 | 状态/发布类型 | synchronized 固定问题相关性 | 官方引用 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| JDK 21 虚拟线程 GA | Virtual threads are pinned in `synchronized` methods | 未找到证据 | This JEP proposes to finalize virtual threads in JDK 21 with the following chang… | New candidate JEP: 444: Virtual Threads | 未找到证据 |
| synchronized pinning 改善版本 | **Since Java 24, “virtual threads can acquire, hold, and release monitors, indep… | 未找到证据 | The following JEP is proposed to target JDK 24: 491: Synchronize Virtual Threads… | 未找到证据 | The following JEP is proposed to target JDK 24: 491: Synchronize Virtual Threads… |

## 已验证结论

### This JEP proposes to finalize virtual threads in JDK 21 with the following changes from JDK 20, informed by developer feedback:

- 研究项：`JDK 21 虚拟线程 GA · 状态/发布类型`
- 候选：`906bbd4f-e0df-4baf-a87f-09bbdea5d61f`
- Evidence: `evidence:ac8a0967942c494f68306404e7c5378161248fc273a67370`
  - Exact quote: “This JEP proposes to finalize virtual threads in JDK 21 with the following changes from JDK 20, informed by developer feedback:”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/dd9b0edc-d6d6-4fcf-b456-ec69c773a9a6/0c4640a1fb3d961e2f98e45fb0e08be26320f5f3c596cef28834797c198fdfe6`
  - URL: https://openjdk.org/jeps/444

### New candidate JEP: 444: Virtual Threads

- 研究项：`JDK 21 虚拟线程 GA · synchronized 固定问题相关性`
- 候选：`32dd6cc9-d285-4940-83f6-d03f553830c1`
- Evidence: `evidence:6aaf6b2e0e6ebfbd2bde5d34ceb8037126be1604a9ad3c67`
  - Exact quote: “New candidate JEP: 444: Virtual Threads”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/dd9b0edc-d6d6-4fcf-b456-ec69c773a9a6/4301fec906dcc09f69dc02fa97b93aca8f8a0f75d46c2b76023dcf06484580a9`
  - URL: https://mail.openjdk.org/archives/list/jdk-dev@openjdk.org/thread/MCUCCBYYTQVZ2VH2AP2BEA6KRMPNZIDU/

### Virtual threads are pinned in \`synchronized\` methods

- 研究项：`JDK 21 虚拟线程 GA · JDK 版本号`
- 候选：`8db3561a-152f-49f5-bbe4-e7a08de2783a`
- Evidence: `evidence:c7a4b9be51a69496100a12ab1c9ea9d5e17d7026ac7b9083`
  - Exact quote: “Virtual threads are pinned in \`synchronized\` methods”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/ab854afa-1a7e-41b3-9ed8-fcbf6a3adbf9/6e7bdc334b989369f3a8fe12f36bac2e2eafda35620284aefc221212d7666241`
  - URL: https://openjdk.org/jeps/491

### The following JEP is proposed to target JDK 24: 491: Synchronize Virtual Threads without Pinning https://openjdk.org/jeps/491

- 研究项：`synchronized pinning 改善版本 · 官方引用`
- 候选：`4ffb373d-0ea4-4369-be6d-cc4e0ed6cd9a`
- Evidence: `evidence:3d8281ed61b91a8f6a61a5a7eb3c6cd1624a9c94b6aaf2b6`
  - Exact quote: “The following JEP is proposed to target JDK 24: 491: Synchronize Virtual Threads without Pinning https://openjdk.org/jeps/491”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/dae29baa-e2a9-4b70-ae87-fec289d4f6a4/3e05bc2042967e9bbe51cc3aa7385df15375f8be98593d41428681c81569d01d`
  - URL: https://mail.openjdk.org/pipermail/jdk-dev/2024-November/009600.html

### The following JEP is proposed to target JDK 24: 491: Synchronize Virtual Threads without Pinning https://openjdk.org/jeps/491 Summary: Improve the scalability of Java code that uses synchronized methods and statements by arranging for virtual threads that block in such constructs to release their underlying platform threads for use by ot

- 研究项：`synchronized pinning 改善版本 · 状态/发布类型`
- 候选：`2bca6545-d24e-44e6-94ea-7447156cc2bc`
- Evidence: `evidence:ded34666eaa85dbf1ca8f1cc18ca6666cf121f15b192c6ac`
  - Exact quote: “The following JEP is proposed to target JDK 24: 491: Synchronize Virtual Threads without Pinning https://openjdk.org/jeps/491 Summary: Improve the scalability of Java code that uses synchronized methods and statements by arranging for virtual threads that block in such constructs to release their underlying platform threads for use by ot”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/dae29baa-e2a9-4b70-ae87-fec289d4f6a4/3e05bc2042967e9bbe51cc3aa7385df15375f8be98593d41428681c81569d01d`
  - URL: https://mail.openjdk.org/pipermail/jdk-dev/2024-November/009600.html

### **Since Java 24, “virtual threads can acquire, hold, and release monitors, independently of their carriers”**.

- 研究项：`synchronized pinning 改善版本 · JDK 版本号`
- 候选：`2e2e95d9-32b1-489c-ad1f-24aea51560da`
- Evidence: `evidence:1ed7888b1012615865c088a5c32ce373ef01d5f7653c01d2`
  - Exact quote: “**Since Java 24, “virtual threads can acquire, hold, and release monitors, independently of their carriers”**.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/5b58f1c9-6a5d-4ef0-b59e-dc3eb01ed456/9d0664762ac86b0f40b668332333f23b9904dda4d187670acb58e717fcf9d8da`
  - URL: https://mikemybytes.com/2025/04/09/java24-thread-pinning-revisited/

## 局限与未解决项

- **JDK 21 虚拟线程 GA · 官方引用**：必需研究项未找到足够证据（`REQUIRED_CELL_UNRESOLVED`，`GAP`）
- **JDK 21 虚拟线程 GA · JEP 编号与标题**：必需研究项未找到足够证据（`REQUIRED_CELL_UNRESOLVED`，`GAP`）
- **synchronized pinning 改善版本 · synchronized 固定问题相关性**：必需研究项未找到足够证据（`REQUIRED_CELL_UNRESOLVED`，`GAP`）
- **synchronized pinning 改善版本 · JEP 编号与标题**：必需研究项未找到足够证据（`REQUIRED_CELL_UNRESOLVED`，`GAP`）
- REQUIRED_CELLS_PARTIALLY_RESOLVED
- UNRESOLVED_CELLS_REMAIN

## 完成判定原因

- REQUIRED_CELLS_PARTIALLY_RESOLVED
- UNRESOLVED_CELLS_REMAIN

brief.scope: 仅覆盖 OpenJDK 官方发布信息与 JEP 文档：虚拟线程的正式 GA 版本与 JEP，以及涉及 synchronized 导致虚拟线程固定问题改善的 JDK 版本与 JEP/发布说明。
brief.objective: 确定 Java 虚拟线程正式发布的 JDK 版本及其 JEP，以及 synchronized 导致的线程固定（pinning）问题在哪个 JDK 版本得到改善，并指出对应 JEP 或权威来源。
exclusions: 不比较第三方库（如 Spring、Quarkus）对虚拟线程的适配策略
不评估不同 JDK 发行版（Oracle、Temurin 等）之间的差异
不覆盖虚拟线程性能调优细节
